cohort: The study cohort consisted of primigravid women in Finland who had an induced abortion between 2000-2015 and a subsequent live singleton birth, along with age- and residential area-matched controls whose first pregnancy was a live birth.
finding: A history of induced abortion is associated with increased odds for fear of childbirth in a subsequent pregnancy (aOR 1.20, 95% CI 1.11-1.30).
